policy: V24 consumes fee-budgeted MetaPay settlement/utilization v2 and posts settled owner-distribution principal and actually incurred external settlement fees as separate canonical accounting entries. Owner-distribution principal remains EXTERNAL_CAPITAL and excluded from realized P&L. Actual payer-borne external fees are EXTERNAL_EXPENSE and therefore reduce realized external P&L. Unused authorized fee budget is not posted and is not profit.

additions.authority_note: Evidence-derived decision over MetaPay DistributionBatchAttempt/SettlementReceipt/Utilization v2. Separately derives settled principal and actual external fee. Principal posts as OWNER_DISTRIBUTION external capital and is excluded from realized P&L. Actual fee posts as OWNER_DISTRIBUTION_SETTLEMENT_FEE external expense and reduces realized external P&L.
